related.title: Elasticsearch：PIT搜尋分頁與鑑識匯出重現性
related.titleEn: Elasticsearch: PIT pagination and reproducible forensic exports
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付標籤決策表、120/24000串流清單與兩租戶查詢樣本，附峰值資源假設及欄位保留理由。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver label decisions, both stream enumerations and two-tenant queries, with resource assumptions and field-retention rationale.
related.difference: 使用唯一排序tie-breaker與固定查詢條件建立匯出清單，記錄每頁游標、筆數、首尾ID及快照範圍。
related.differenceEn: Define a unique tie-breaker and fixed query, recording cursors, counts, boundary IDs and snapshot scope for every export page.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 完全組合的上界是各標籤取值數乘積；實際基數需由觀察集合計數，不可把上界當實測。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 教學資料有10服務、4環境、3區域，且每組都有事件；另有200個請求ID跨全部組合出現。 穩定標籤產生10×4×3=120串流；把請求ID加進去變24000串流。
匯出完整性需同時檢查唯一數與預期集合；總行數正確仍可能由重複與遺漏互相抵消。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 預期1000個ID，匯出每頁100列共10頁；跨頁漂移使20個ID重複且20個預期ID缺席。 檔案仍1000列，但唯一ID只有980，預期覆蓋980/1000=98%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The Cartesian-product upper bound multiplies label cardinalities; observed stream counts require actual distinct tuples. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The fixture populates all combinations of ten services, four environments and three regions; two hundred request IDs also cross every combination. Stable labels produce 120 streams; including request ID yields 24000 streams in this fully populated fixture.

Export completeness requires unique counts and expected-set comparison; duplicate and missing rows can cancel in total counts. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Expect 1000 IDs across ten pages of one hundred rows; pagination drift duplicates twenty IDs and omits twenty expected IDs. The file still contains 1000 rows, but only 980 unique expected IDs, producing 98% coverage.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Prometheus：for持續條件與評估時刻盲點
related.titleEn: Prometheus: for-duration and evaluation-time blind spots
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付標籤決策表、120/24000串流清單與兩租戶查詢樣本，附峰值資源假設及欄位保留理由。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver label decisions, both stream enumerations and two-tenant queries, with resource assumptions and field-retention rationale.
related.difference: 建立評估時刻、條件值、pending起點及firing時刻表，將缺資料與false分開處理。
related.differenceEn: Tabulate evaluation times, condition values, pending start and firing time, distinguishing missing samples from false conditions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 完全組合的上界是各標籤取值數乘積；實際基數需由觀察集合計數，不可把上界當實測。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 教學資料有10服務、4環境、3區域，且每組都有事件；另有200個請求ID跨全部組合出現。 穩定標籤產生10×4×3=120串流；把請求ID加進去變24000串流。

若第一次觀察true在t0，後續評估皆true，首次可觸發時間是滿足持續時間的下一個評估點。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 每30秒評估，t=0為false，t=30起持續true；for=120秒，忽略排程抖動與通知延遲。 pending從30開始，首次firing在150秒；若實際異常從1秒開始，觀測與持續條件另引入延遲。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The Cartesian-product upper bound multiplies label cardinalities; observed stream counts require actual distinct tuples. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The fixture populates all combinations of ten services, four environments and three regions; two hundred request IDs also cross every combination. Stable labels produce 120 streams; including request ID yields 24000 streams in this fully populated fixture.

With true first observed at t0 and every later evaluation true, firing begins at the first evaluation satisfying the duration. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Evaluate every thirty seconds: false at zero and continuously true from thirty onward, with for=120 seconds and no scheduling jitter. Pending starts at thirty and first firing occurs at 150 seconds; an actual onset at second one introduces additional observation delay.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
